Premium per minute = sum(volume x vwap x 100), calls C and puts P separately.
signal: closed minute t in 15..330: C15 = sum of C over t-14..t >= 5 x baseline AND C15 >= 3 x P15 AND C15 >= $50,000, where baseline = mean 15-minute call premium of the name's prior 5 study days (their daily call premium / 26); refractory 30 minutes per name

entries (timing modes).loose: the first minute t' in t..t+15 with fast %R (21, EWM 7) >= -50 and rising (catalyst_primary.loose_ok); open of t'+1; none -> no trade

exits.atr: catalyst_primary.vol_exit (2 ATR stop / 4 ATR target / 60 min)

cost: real SIP quoted spread at entry (news_source.fetch_quotes); spread > 6 bp is not traded (the live gate); net = gross - spread

pass_each (4 cells: now/loose x atr/clos.both_halves: mean net > 0 in both date halves

information_only: a same-name random-minute control on the signal's day (seed sha256('ocf'|day|sym)), lift vs control; put-heavy bursts (P15 >= 5 x put baseline and >= 3 x C15) long return; signal count per day and opens per 10 minutes; time-of-day buckets
